symmetraBarrierUtilityFlex.observation: Symmetra blocked is represented through barrier_utility_flex, while mapRating remains bounded by the 9.8 cap.

lucioTempoMainSupport.observation: Lúcio is evaluated through tempo_main_support, so assists/survival/blocked keep low healing from burying the rating.

tankProfileCheck.observation: disrupt_tank lowers blocked weight, while poke_tank can still recognize blocked/damage without using one shared tank pool only.

damageFlexSupport.observation: Illari/Zenyatta damage and elims are represented, and damage_flex_support is exempt from the support healing soft cap.

highDamageHighDeathsDps.observation: High damage rows with low survival are surfaced for review so damage alone does not imply top-end rating.
